propositions.name: Vintage
propositions.claim: With documents, outcome and counting rule fixed, a novelty measure read from the current record is more positively associated with the outcome than the same measure read from the record as published.
propositions.refuted_by: a type-matched difference below 1 percentage point

propositions.name: Decision-coupled writing
propositions.claim: The record of a decided case is written again at its disposition, and the measure read at disposition is more strongly associated with the outcome than the record before it.
propositions.refuted_by: not tested by the plan; the evidence is descriptive and was added after the freeze

propositions.name: Outcome-dependent revision after the decision
propositions.claim: Classification information created after the decision is related to the decision.
propositions.refuted_by: an association inside a preregistered region of practical equivalence

propositions.name: Reconstruction
propositions.claim: Revision made after an observation window closed tracks what the field later made of the invention.
propositions.state: supported in one channel, not separable from maintenance driven by use
